text: {"lessons":["I sold several winners for modest gains, but gains alone are not a reason to sell; I should weigh each position against my plan and prospects.","Buying Stock A at a much higher price and later selling at a steep loss showed me that I should check my reasons before buying and reassess them objectively, rather than let reluctance to admit a mistake guide me.","After losses in A and B, I should avoid reactive trades and frequent checking; each new purchase, including my Stock C buy, should fit a clear plan and my available cash."]}
